matched_reference_diagnostic.fixed_assumptions: Receiver setup/hold, paired four-corner pad-tail and 0/30pF endpoint-load envelopes, reference uncertainty, outward guards and zero board flight/skew retained. Only the explicitly baked native-slow100 clock-route component is replaced by its directly observed same-corner interval.
matched_reference_diagnostic.remaining: Other cell/LUT/PLL/pad and continuous-load bounds, actual board/HPS/reset/CDC, public multi-corner integration, fresh authenticated producers and exact-artifact hardware acceptance remain unqualified.

derivation: The existing contract explicitly includes the native slow100 rising clock-egress interval. For each retained corner, replace only that interval: new output max = old output max + old clock early - observed clock early; new output min = old output min + old clock late - observed clock late. Changed values receive an additional outward 1 ps guard. Chip setup/hold, paired four-corner pad-tail and endpoint-load envelopes, reference uncertainties, phase/frequency and board assumptions remain fixed.
evidence_boundary: Conditional host screen only. Raw observations require the exact declared top-level unregistered clock output, its real reference net, clock-buffer driver, BEL owner and physical net-owned GOUT cut. No estimated source or fabricated clock. Every parent failed capture is retained; original slow100 controls reproduce exactly. No full native fast-corner, physical board or hardware acceptance.
remaining: Other cell/LUT/PLL/pad and continuous-load bounds, actual board/HPS/reset/CDC, public multi-corner integration, fresh authenticated producers and exact-artifact hardware acceptance remain unqualified.
